svg.aria-label: Claude Observability Agent high-level design on OCI OKE

g.text: AI-assisted SRE for Oracle Kubernetes Engine · CronJob every 5 min · detect → collect → pre-pass → Claude tool-use analysis → Teams approval → remediate · a human approves every mutation
Runs as a CronJob every 5 min,
Helm-owned drift → a PR to the
chart values, not a live patch
The agent has no ingress at all —
every acronym used in this diagram
Fix lands as a PR to chart values

Loop: K8s API → detect → collect (events, Loki / kubectl logs, Tempo-correlated timeline) → pre-pass hints → Claude (live PromQL / LogQL / TraceQL) → Teams card → @mention approval → policy-checked kubectl → post-check → outcome stored
Read cluster-wide, write narrow · nothing mutates without a human · secrets stay in the cluster (claude-agent-secrets) · Helm-owned drift is fixed in Git, not in place
